custom_logic_notes: Martingale recovery system: after a losing trade, the EA increases lot size by a configurable multiplier. It tracks a group of positions and closes all when the cumulative profit of the group exceeds a target. The EA uses multi-indicator confluence (MA crossover confirmed by MACD direction and RSI level) for entry signals. SL/TP values are adjusted for 5-digit brokers by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
python_conversion_notes: The martingale position management is the hardest part to replicate — must track position groups and cumulative P&L across the group. Multi-indicator confluence is straightforward with TA-Lib/pandas_ta. SL/TP digit adjustment logic must be replicated. The group close logic (close all when total profit > target) requires tracking open positions by symbol/direction group. Margin check before martingale scaling is critical to avoid account blow-up.
